verdict.rationale: FireHydrant is an incident management platform with built-in AI features such as Copilot, summaries and drafted retrospectives, so letting it connect to external MCP servers as a client is a fair question. The evidence only shows an official FireHydrant MCP server that exposes its API to other agents. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story, and nothing documents plugging third-party MCP servers into FireHydrant.
